final: WITH exam_counts AS (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p.SEX), ''), '(blank/missing)') AS sex_group, COUNT(*) AS examined FROM Examination e LEFT JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = e.ID GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p.SEX), ''), '(blank/missing)')), totals AS (SELECT SUM(examined) AS overall_total, AVG(examined) AS per_sex_average FROM exam_counts), above_average AS (SELECT * FROM exam_counts CROSS JOIN totals WHERE examined > per_sex_average) SELECT 'sex' AS row_type, sex_group, examined, 1.0 * examined / overall_total AS share_of_total, NULL AS average_share, NULL AS average_amount_above_per_sex_average FROM exam_counts CROSS JOIN totals UNION ALL SELECT 'above_average_combined', NULL, SUM(examined), NULL, AVG(1.0 * examined / overall_total), AVG(examined - per_sex_average) FROM above_average
